name: freduce
title: Apply a list of functions sequentially

origin.description: Apply the first function to a value, then each later function to the previous result.
origin.details: Every function but the last is applied in a loop. The last function is applied on its own, and its visibility is kept. A list of one function skips the loop. An empty list selects that missing last function and fails.
origin.value: The result after applying each function in turn.

translation.description: Apply the first function to a value, then each later function to the previous result.
translation.details: A list of one callable is applied once. A longer list applies every callable but the last, then the last. An empty list raises the installed R error, attempt to select less than one element in integerOneIndex.
translation.value: The result of the last callable.
translation.example:
from math import sqrt
from magrittr.fseq import freduce
freduce(16, [sqrt])
